title: Las Escadas Rally
style: Latin pop-reggaeton with a midtempo dembow groove, handclap accents, and bright marimba plucks; verse rides lean percussion and sparse bass, pre-chorus lifts with filtered crowd chants and rising percussion, chorus hits with a chantable hook and brass stabs. Lead vocal stays close-mic and confident with stacked doubles, gang vocals on the anchor phrase, short delay throws on key names, and tropical ear candy like reversed shakers and beachy risers into each drop. Mix is bright, punchy, and festival-ready.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
December brings the fire
San Juan del Sur awake
Las Escadas in the spotlight
You can feel the whole place shake
Nicaragua holds the banner
PFA Americas on the floor
Delegations rolling in
From every border, wanting more

[Pre-Chorus]
Hear that call
Feel that rise
First of all
It changes lives
From the first serve
To the last cheer
This is bigger
Everybody's here

[Chorus]
Las Escadas + Pickleball
Las Escadas + Pickleball
Make it loud, make it proud
Campeonato lights the crowd
Las Escadas + Pickleball
Las Escadas + Pickleball
December two to six
History in every hit

[Verse 2]
Campeonato Centroamericano
Written in the sun
Central America on one court
And the whole world watching one
Fast hands, quick steps
Bright shots cross the net
A landmark for the region
They won't forget it yet
